enchantments.tooltip: Eversight: You benefit from the spell True Seeing and are Immune to Blindness.

Improved Deception: This item makes your weapons hard to focus upon and thus provides a +20 enhancement bonus to Bluff checks. In addition, while using this item your weapons have a chance to envelop the target in darkness, making them vulnerable to sneak attacks for a short time.
Search +20: Passive: +20 Competence bonus to the Search skill.
Spot +20: Passive: +20 Competence bonus to the Spot skill.
Reflex Save +12: This item gives a +12 Resistance bonus to your Reflex saves.

Legendary Saltmarsh Explorer: 5 Pieces Equipped:+30 Artifact bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Rating+15 Artifact bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power+3 Artifact bonus to all Ability Scores+30 Artifact Bonus to Positive, Negative, and Repair Amplification
